title: Locality of τ(M, θ, ξ): agreement up to null sets on an open set
statement:
Let P, k ∈ ℕ, M, M' ⊆ ℝ^P, θ, θ' : ℝ^P → ℝ, ξ, ξ' : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (k-vectors), and V ⊆ ℝ^P open. Suppose Hᵏ((M Δ M') ∩ V) = 0, and θ = θ' and ξ = ξ' hold Hᵏ⌞(M ∩ V)-a.e. Then for every k-form ω : ℝ^P → Λᵏ(ℝ^P) (no regularity assumed) with tsupport ω ⊆ V:
∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵏ = ∫_{M'} θ'(x)·ξ'(x)(ω(x)) dHᵏ,
i.e. tauAction k M θ ξ ω = tauAction k M' θ' ξ' ω (Bochner integrals; no integrability assumed).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Eucl P)) (θ θ' : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ ξ' : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (V : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen V → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff M M' ∩ V) = 0 → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ V)), θ x = θ' x ∧ ξ x = ξ' x) → ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k, tsupport ω ⊆ V → tauAction k M θ ξ ω = tauAction k M' θ' ξ' ω
